summary: Implementation plan for an interactive single-player Dungeons & Dragons game featuring an infinite campaign in a classic high-fantasy realm. The game includes character creation with race/class combinations, an AI Dungeon Master powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash, interactive 3D/animated d20 dice rolls for 5e checks and combat, contextual preselected action cards alongside custom text actions, persistent inventory/XP/loot progression, and a minimalist modern fantasy interface with clean typography and wood textures.
